notes.title: New Bundle Release - Jogos Brasileiros
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/c24d9bd3f1354059a3e7bcd151183775cce90dce.png[/img]

Hello Everyone!

We would like to announce that one of titles, [b]The Darkest Island[/b] has entered a new promotional bundle.

This Bundle, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6822/Jogos_Brasileiros/]JOGOS BRASILEIROS[/url] it's possible find different games from Brazilian Inde Game developers.

In this new package the minimum promotion is 20%.
This is a good time to acquire our game in partnership with Gamix Studios.
If you already own our title and want to complete a collection of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6822/Jogos_Brasileiros/]JOGOS BRASILEIROS[/url] this is [b]your chance![/b]

Thank you for joining us in our indie studio. If you notice something that seems to be wrong, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1363390/discussions/]report it as bug[/url]!

And that's what I have for you today. See you all soon!

notes.title: New Bundle release - Cute Puzzles
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are pleased to announce that our games:
[i]Invisible Places[/i] and [i]Invisible Services[/i]
They are members of a new bundle!
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40007110/4664d40195ac9da8ef42ff7b7e346d32b88c67f4.png[/img]

It's a very strong bundle, with several games of different and common themes in a single aspect, [b]the games are amazing![/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24830]Cute Puzzle[/url]

All games are from independent developers in Brazil.
Thanks for listening! a big digital and safe hug for everyone ♥
